### Why `no`, with the precedent named

The change is **catalogue data plus a call site plus a pin**. Even on the plural-family route the additions are **catalogue keys** behind an existing published entry — ⛔ not a new exported symbol and ⛔ not a new key on a published *payload*; ⛔ no `packages/spec/src/**` path. The direct precedent is objectui#8631 / PR objectui#9654, landed this shift: one new catalogue key across the same ten packs, declared `no`, re-measured at delivery, and it held.

⚠️ **Standing instruction to the dev: re-measure at delivery.** If your route reaches an exported symbol or a schema in `packages/i18n`, declare `yes` in your report.

### ⛔ The hard constraint, quoted because it is the one that can be got wrong quietly

Triage (`5707816850`):

> 那条钉子必须**按新值重新推导**,⛔ 不是删掉。删钉子会让下一次回归无人看守;而照抄旧钉子会把缺陷再钉一遍。

⇒ `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` currently asserts `ru`'s bare genitive plural **as correct**. ⭐ **A regression pin that has grown around a defect will block every attempt to fix it, and it looks exactly like a healthy pin — it is green.** Re-derive it against the new values; ⛔ deleting it and ⛔ copying it forward are both failures.

### ⛔ The analogy that is explicitly refused, and it is refused correctly

objectui#9170 asked the same question about `kanban.columns` and was **ruled** — route 3, drop the number from the string (director seat, decision batch #118 item 3). ⛔ **That is not this card's answer.** On a kanban board the count is redundant, the lanes being visible; in a commit-history row **the count is the content**, and dropping it deletes information.

⇒ the live routes are a real `_one`/`_other` family (keys required in **all ten** packs by `all-locales-key-parity`, only the *value* may repeat), an `en`-style count-agnostic device per pack, or the parenthetical/colon form at `fields.textarea.charactersRemaining`. ⭐ Triage's words: 这是「做哪个,几个都行」,**不是**「选哪个」 ⇒ pick one and say why.

⚠️ **The reverse exit stays open**: if the tradeoff turns out to sit in **product tone** rather than grammar — whether that row shows a number at all — ⛔ hand it back rather than self-ruling inside the card.

### Staleness pre-checks

| face | reading |
|:--|:--|
| grading | triage graded it **today** at `2026-09-17T03:02Z`; ⛔ nothing has moved since |
| action surface | `CommitTimeline.tsx`, the ten packs and the pin file — ⛔ no open PR of this seat's touches any of them |
| card references | objectui#9170 **ruled** (batch #118 item 3) — ⚠️ read for reasoning, ⛔ not applied by analogy |
| work items | ⚠️ the card states its own limit: reachability at `itemCount === 1` is **derived** from the call site and pack values, ⛔ **not run**. The dispatch makes rendering it the first deliverable |

### Tier gate — hand-derived, and here is the run that says it must be

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectui --tier …` exits **2, REFUSING** a cross-repo answer. Hand-derived: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test` · `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` · `type-check` · `lint` · `check-changeset-presence` · `check-control-bytes` · and the i18n family this diff reaches directly — `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-i18n-dead-keys`, `check-eager-locale-catalogues` (⚠️ it answers PREREQUISITE NOT MET without a build first, and that is ⛔ not a pass). ⚠️ Hand-derived, therefore fallible.

### Serial constraints cleared

**objectui#6379** is in flight from this seat — `apps/console/src/index.css` and `apps/console`'s build config. ⛔ Disjoint from `packages/i18n/**` and `packages/app-shell/src/preview/**`. objectui#7727 closed `completed` this round; objectui#7804 slice 6 was withdrawn. ⛔ No PR of this seat's is open. Lock read before dispatch: `lock is free`, `queue: empty` ⇒ arrival depth 1.
